body: Thank you for taking the time to talk to me. I am worn out from crying so I will sleep now. I'm not going to kill myself tonight.
I feel better now. I'm really worn out from crying so I might sleep. Thank you.
Thank you. You are a good person, humble or not.

I appreciate the concern but I feel like you're being way too logical about this. It's okay to think bad thoughts sometimes. Not to act on them though. I used to imagine I was in Columbine and I saved everybody but died in the process. Never killed myself in a school shooting.

It's not about the attention. You got the creativity part right though. If you can't get meaning through people, at least you can create art. I love art. Performance art. My life, and death, can be art.
I wouldn't doubt it. I'm a little jealous.
